QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_49

question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund's compliance team identifies a breach of the 2x leverage cap during Q2. Under the regulatory framework, this must be:

answer.text: Reported immediately to the custodian, investors and SEBI with square-off action, and also disclosed in the quarterly CTR
Referred to RBI for regulatory action

explanation.text: The Logic: A breach of the 2x leverage limit triggers an immediate breach-reporting obligation: the Manager must report the breach to the custodian, to investors and to SEBI, and must square off the excess exposure. The breach is also disclosed in the quarterly Compliance Test Report (CTR). The Trap: Internal correction (B) violates the disclosure obligation. AGM-only disclosure (C) bypasses SEBI and the custodian. RBI (D) is the wrong regulator for AIFs (SEBI is the regulator). Note: The leverage cap is expressed as total exposure (including borrowing and derivative exposure) over NAV after permitted offsetting, capped at 2x. Breach-reporting and CTR disclosure are covered in the workbook on pp. 349-350 and 409-410.
